description: Surfaces that the UI/UX scoring programme must capture. Derived from the App Router tree (src/app/**/page.tsx) and the workspace registry (GITHUB_PROJECT_WORKSPACE_MAPPINGS in src/lib/github-project-sync.ts). Verified by scripts/derive-captured-surfaces.ts, which fails when the app serves a route this file does not list. See mission-control-kanban#142.

surfaces.note: Workspace dashboard and app entry point.
MemSys cockpit (GitHub Project #12). Found by the derivation gate on its first run: this cockpit had never been in the surface list either.
Frontend Revenue cockpit (GitHub Project #15). Added to this list by #142 after shipping in 690a5fb without ever being captured.
